name: r1104_s_turning
hookRule: A 48 inch room. Watch the wheelchair try to turn.
script: This room is forty-eight inches wide. Watch the wheelchair try to turn around.
It can't. The ADA wants a sixty inch circle clear, so a wheelchair can turn all the way around. Widen the room twelve inches, and it works.
